title: Where to Eat and Shop at the Barlow in Sebastopol
abstract: A fire pit, bocce courts and public lawns invite visitors to linger at a development called the Barlow in Sonoma County.

title: American Barbecue in Paris
abstract: American food used to be a “goofy novelty” to the French, but now they’re tucking into ribs, pork belly and wings, with all the sides.

title: Where to Eat and Drink in Evanston
abstract: The urban suburb north of Chicago has a downtown area that is picking up steam with the recent openings of farm-to-table restaurants and world-class distilleries and breweries.
